data.name: Sunilraj
data.gender_notes: Sunilraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sunilraj is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Surya' (Sun) and 'Raja' (King, Ruler). The name suggests a powerful, courageous, and fearless individual who rules over his domain with the radiance of the sun. The name Sunilraj carries the meaning “Radiant Sun, Brave Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sunilraj usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant sun, brave ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to a child who is believed to be a manifestation of the divine sun god, Surya, and a future leader who will bring light and strength to his people.

historical_references.reference:
Sunilraj was a famous Hindu king in medieval India, who ruled over the region of Karnataka from 1234 to 1264 AD. He was a powerful ruler, who expanded his kingdom through military conquests and diplomacy.
Context: Sunilraj was the founder of the Hoysala Empire's second dynasty, which came to be known as the Haley Dynasty.

Sunilraj also played a significant role in Hinduism during the Bhakti Movement. He was a great patron of the poet-saints, such as Saint Allasani Peddanna and Saint Basaveshwara. He sponsored their works and provided them with land grants for their temples and monasteries.
Context: The Bhakti Movement was a major spiritual and cultural development in Hinduism, which emphasized the importance of devotion and love towards God.
